prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-KIT: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. WD-ZOE: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. Equal standing height. Use ONLY named scene cast; never add a child to natural-subject nonfiction. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: Books for Our Class; World Discovery; fiction.
Setting: An ordinary school library joined by a level indoor corridor to one classroom, daytime.
Locked recurring subjects/props: Four unbranded picture books: blue, green, orange, purple covers with simple drawings but no writing; Small tan cloth bag; Low red four-wheeled book cart with black handle; Two classmates: short auburn-haired child in green; dark straight-haired child in orange
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use the props' initial state; no future story events, no captions. The book's visual premise is: Kit and Zoe beside a low red cart containing four bright picture books; the classroom doorway beyond shows two children waiting at a reading rug.

visualReview.note: Directly viewed four distinctive covers (blue globe, green elephant, orange volcano, purple ringed planet), tan bag and red two-shelf cart with four casters/black handle. Kit/Zoe and two unnamed classmates separated; library and classroom location keys reviewed.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent image and sequence inspection; no classroom or physical-device observation.
